regime_context: The TSX theme rotation detector shows Big Banks as the dominant leader (score 1.5, durability bar 0.71, breadth 1.0, eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate). The rotation is broad (11 of 16 themes eligible) and not one-narrative. Big Banks is crowded (z 1.16), which warrants sizing caution but not a fade. The gate historically helped control drawdowns on this market, but no predictive return edge exists. Cross-sectional momentum is only a focus lens.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks sits atop the momentum rank and has passed the absolute-trend gate, suggesting staying power and reduced tail risk. Its high durability bar (0.71) and full breadth support persistence over the next month, while the gate-validated risk control encourages participation. Crowding (z 1.16) limits upside and signals size-down, not a fade. The lean is conditional on trend-health metrics holding.
theses.dissent: Crowding could signal exhaustion, and external macro shocks (AI/geopolitics headlines) may trigger a swift sector rotation away from banks. Durability could plummet if credit conditions deteriorate abruptly.

falsifier.text: Overweight is invalidated if Big Banks becomes ineligible (trend gate flips false) OR durability bar drops below 0.5 OR breadth falls below 0.7.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
